d:
In Dikshant’s words: “A song inspired by weddings, the inexpressible feeling of the bride and groom. When they're in the same house but can barely talk to each other - They say, "Tum aakhon se batana, hum samajh jaayenge." This song is for your soulmate. When you truly love someone, You don't need actions or words to communicate, Your eyes say it all.”
